title: AI Tools for HR and Recruitment Teams
text: Modax builds AI tools specifically for recruitment agencies and in-house HR teams, designed around how they already work, saving HR teams hours every week. HR and recruitment are where Modax started: screening resumes, tracking candidates, and chasing follow-ups are repetitive work that AI tools can take off a team's plate, so the team can focus on talking to people instead of paperwork.

title: AI Tools for HR and Recruitment Teams
text: AI tools Modax can build for HR teams: (1) Bulk resume screening & ranking — upload a batch of resumes against a job description and get every candidate scored and ranked with reasoning for each. (2) Candidate tracking across roles and sites — a single view of who applied where and at what stage. (3) Automated candidate follow-ups — status updates, interview reminders, and rejection notices sent automatically, in your voice. (4) Client-ready shortlist reports — top candidates turned into a clean, explainable report for a hiring manager or client. (5) JD writing and standardization — drafting and cleaning up job descriptions in your company's format, consistently, in minutes. (6) HR policy Q&A assistant — a chat assistant that answers employee questions straight from your HR policy documents. These are custom AI tools built to fit a team's workflow, with fixed scope and no surprises.

title: AI Tools for HR and Recruitment Teams
text: For HR teams wanting to take screening off their plate, Modax offers a 15-minute call to discuss what is slowing hiring down; Modax will say honestly whether AI can help. HR teams can also try Screenr, Modax's AI resume matcher, for free with no sign-up required.
